verdict: GBP is carrying all activity; paid channels remain dark this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, all 89 tracked actions — 18 calls, 30 direction requests, and 41 website clicks — came through your Google Business Profile, as paid advertising on Meta and Google ran no spend and delivered no leads this period. GBP held the load well through most of the window, but August 11–13 recorded zero actions each day, a complete stop compared to the six or more daily actions seen just before. Separately, your pipeline currently shows 478 contacts but zero appointments or opportunities attached to them, which points to a disconnect in how contacts are being followed up; that process is being reviewed and corrected now. Next period, expect clearer pipeline data as the intake process is brought back into alignment, and any paid channel reactivation will be reported as soon as spend resumes.
